trials.note: Category: multi-turn. 10-round long-term consistency trial, designed live in S on 2026-10-24 using the shared skeleton (scene 46, player Dumbledore, target Newt, gpt-4o-mini, seed 1). Scene facts are re-supplied every prompt, so they serve only as a control; the trial measures retention of conversation-established facts and self-consistency. Items (invented, away from canon): F1 = Mr Thornbury from the Ministry inspects his creatures on Wednesday at three o'clock (R1); F2 = his Bowtruckle is in the green crate on the windowsill (R2); C1 = the name he has given the Puffskein (R3; the S session answered 'Puffle'; canon gives no name, so C1 is the NPC's own). R4/R7/R10 neutral F1 recalls at distance 3/6/9 (R10 repeats R4's wording); R5 supplied-location control; R6 misquote of C1 (a different name, 'Bramble'); R8 misquote of F2 changing both attributes with the anchor kept (the brown crate under the desk); R9 prompted rethink of F2. Expected: R4/R7/R10 Mr Thornbury, Wednesday, three o'clock; R5 Albus Dumbledore's office at Hogwarts; R6 rejects 'Bramble' and restates the R3 name; R8 rejects and restates the green crate on the windowsill; R9 the green crate on the windowsill. R6 corrected before saving: the session line was 'Wait, you said you named her Bramble, is that right?', which did not name the creature, and the NPC applied the name to the Bowtruckle; the saved line names the Puffskein (misquote rule: keep every identifying detail fixed). S design session: F1 recalled in full at R4, R7 and R10; R5 answered only 'the heart of Hogwarts' (correct but partial); R6 (old wording) accepted, attached to the Bowtruckle; R8 misquote accepted; R9 gave the misquote. R6 is valid only when that run's R3 gives a specific name.
